counterPressure.note: One raw-stat line (atom.might, low) against a fused rare's two-to-three affixes. The mesmerizing rider is a status.apply proc, not a stat line, so it never enters the raw-stat sum the ceiling checks.

entries.flavor: Rigged from a hose nozzle and a rusted sight, it was never built to aim true. It was built to make the target forget which way true was.

entries.name: Commandeered Yoke

counterPressure.note: One raw-stat line (atom.plating, low) against a fused rare's two-to-three affixes. The econ-toll rider banks currency on being struck rather than adding a stat, so it does not enter the raw-stat sum.

entries.flavor: Requisitioned twice, returned once, requisitioned again. The paperwork is lost. The plating never was.
entries.notes: ROLE BREAK, SANCTIONED: atom.econ-toll's authored `roles` (g.economy) are girdle/jewel-major/jewel-minor-a/jewel-minor-b - ward-array is not among them. A unique's fixed atoms are not drawn from the affix pool, so no affix_pool_tag filter ever applies to them (ssot-uniques.md §3.5's rule-breaking ladder, rung 2, the same device the unique exemplar demonstrates). No MACHINE rule is touched: resource.economy's OnDamageTaken trigger is one of its four legal events. atom.plating and atom.carapace are both role-legal for ward-array AND frame-legal for humanoid (frames: [humanoid, hybrid] in g-armour.json - this is not a plant unique, so the arm1Max/arm2Max fields are real, per the exemplar's own frame-filter carve-out). baseType item.humanoid-shoulders-b-002 grepped from data/seed/items/base-types/humanoid-ward-array-b.json (scale class, frame humanoid, band b). Name: adjective 'Commandeered' from themeAdjectivePools['rusted-legion'] + noun 'Yoke' from nounPools['ward-array.humanoid'], compound pattern.
